title: Integrate the R437 carrier compiler, numerical invoice and paid local caller
body:

It meets the assignment's **B enabling-integration gate**, including a paid local Program-reuse improvement; the complete pooled physical supplier bill remains open.

Active requested bases 529→530; code width remains 6512 at q=3. The old pooling width increment is already paid. - Connects reverse coefficient 1,123,650 to the named 192/512 invoice, proves a new per-edge bad-low-class bound for the fresh split projectors under the completeGL64 cover, and updates source-width-aware logical reserve/compatible-stock bounds. A certified q=2^127−1 root entry authenticates exact widths, stock and the actual native compiler join. Large-prime execution is metadata/emission; the q=3 physical fixture is semantic-only. - Executes the actual produced/copied Program and directory through a complete 972-bit four-atom GOOD child, protected return, literal D consumer and cleanup, forward and reverse. Record reads 17,950,250→12,819,500; writes 2,468,252→2,386,138; moves 14,425,614→10,805,766. The six residue/index components also decrease. A duplicate constructor is a same-output losing control.
